environment.topology: Linux browser -> local Docker Web/Router/owners in WSL; Windows host shared with other owner programs.

limitations: One functional scan initially failed at its first HTTP GET with socket hang up; the full focused scan then passed in a fresh test process. Web had zero restarts/OOM and no server errors.
The code reduction proves 8426 fewer encoded initial JavaScript bytes, not that it caused every timing difference.
No host programs/security controls stopped. The Windows DevTools antivirus-injected trace is diagnostic only and excluded from Linux acceptance.
No field SLO, arbitrary host contention guarantee, full-reader certification or playable media approval.
